newsitem.title: CANADA: Wajax Ltd says plans public share issue.
newsitem.headline: Wajax Ltd says plans public share issue.

text.p: Wajax Ltd said on Tuesday it has signed an agreement with a group of underwriters to proceed with a public issue of about 850,000 common shares at C$17 per share.
"The proceeds of the proposed common share issue will be used to finance the corporation's ongoing growth strategy," Wajax said in a statement.

Wajax said Empire Ltd has agreed to buy about 650,000 Wajax common shares at the same price to maintain its 43 percent stake in the company. Wajax expects to file a preliminary prospectus for the offering on March 27.
The closing is expected to take place on or about April 17.
